serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
Bot: What is wrong with that stupid fish?!
You: It can take a while, be patient. Wait till it gets tired. That will make it easier.
Bot: It’s like it’s stuck, it won’t move an inch!
You: Stuck? Let me see…
Bot: It’s ok, I will manage.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Fun is over, I will go full strength now.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Shock
Bot: …{{punch}}
Bot: It’s… {{wi}}It’s a pipe?
You: When you told me it won’t move I thought that this could be the case…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: And here I thought I was doing good…
You: Things like that happen! Don’t get bummed out because of it. 
Bot: It’s just… {{wi}}I was so excited to finally catch it.
You: Don’t worry about it! Really! When I started, fish were escaping me left and right so much that I stopped counting.
You: Practice makes perfect. 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Ok, I will try again! 
You: Do you want my help like the last time?
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: Sure…
You: If you bend your arm this way, the hook will go even further. 
Bot: Like this? 
You: Yeah.
I can’t help but get a little excited while being so close to her. We are supposed to be fishing, but our heads aren’t really into it at the moment…
Bot: O-Ok, I will manage the rest, thanks for your help.
You: Good luck. 
You: Oh! It went quite far.
#bot.Expression.noBlush
Bot: It really did! I’m sure I will catch something amazing now!
Bot: I think I got something!
You: That was fast. Is it a boot this time?
Bot: Shut it! It’s much livelier than before! 
Bot: I think I got it!
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
You: Wow, it took you no time.
You: That’s a nice-looking mackerel. Good job.
Bot: My very first fish!
You: It isn’t too big, but it’s a nice catch for the first time. 
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Do you want to keep it or let it go?
Bot: Since it isn’t that big, let’s let it go. Maybe in the future I will catch it again when it gets bigger!
You: Sorry to disappoint, but the ocean is a big place, I doubt you will ever see that fish again.
Bot: I know, but it’s nice to think that way. 
You: If you say so. 
You: Was that enough thrill for your first time?
Bot: Yes! I had a lot of fun! Next time let’s both give it our all!
Next time?
I hope it doesn’t mean she will get mad if I ever go alone from now on... 
Who am I kidding? {f_botName} isn’t that petty, so there shouldn’t be a problem.
